name: arXiv 2503.13565: ML-SpecQD: Multi-Level Speculative Decoding with Quantized Drafts
notes: Paper by Evangelos Georganas, Dhiraj Kalamkar, Alexander Kozlov, Alexander Heinecke (Intel Labs). Proposes multi-level speculative decoding using plug-and-play direct-cast 4-bit (MXFP4) quantized draft models to accelerate memory-bound CPU/edge decoding without fine-tuning separate draft models.
